scope: Announce cancellation when another editor tab changes the persisted dock state while a dock drag is active.

behavior.trigger: The receiving tab listens to the existing sanci-editor-shell-v2 storage event while a drag is active.
behavior.announcement: A másik szerkesztőlapon megváltozott a panelállapot, ezért az átrendezés megszakadt.
behavior.cancel: The drag preview and active interaction are cleared before the remote panel state is applied; a stale drop cannot overwrite it.
behavior.live_region: The existing #workspaceDockStatus role=status aria-live=polite aria-atomic=true is reused.
behavior.storage_clear: The same reason is used for storage clear/reset events covered by the existing dock storage listener.
